paragraphs: R. Meyasha, in the time of the late figures of the Second Temple period. Yuḥasin writes [in Seder HaDorot under Admon and Ḥanan]: Maimonides' statement that he belonged to Admon and Ḥanan's group seems wrong. Pe'ah 2:6 has Naḥum the scribe testify that he received from R. Meyasha, who received from Abba, who received from the pairs. Thus Meyasha lived after Hillel and Shammai, in Hillel's sons' days (see Avtalyon).
